messages:
anne_docs: Heads-up: PR #452 for pricing & telemetry docs is ready for review. Focus areas: meter label examples, tiered quotas migration note, and a suggested Grafana panel export. Need devex + runtime signoff before merge. Link: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/452

mike_runtime: Looping in @clara_devex. Quick question — do we need to add the new metering header example for SDK v2? I updated the curl sample but want to confirm header name.

clara_devex: Yes — header is `X-Redwood-Usage` per spec. Suggested curl snippet (will add JS/Python samples too):
```bash
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer <KEY>' -H 'X-Redwood-Usage: units=42' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

sara_product: UX note: the dashboard panel currently titled "Effective Units" might confuse customers. Suggest renaming to "Billable Units (post-burst)" and add a short tooltip explaining burst credit handling.

kevin_design: Agree with the rename. Also recommend adding a tiny info icon that links to the quota playbook. I'll DM the microcopy.

anne_docs: I'll push a copy tweak in the PR. @mike_runtime can you confirm retention windows for telemetry? Docs currently say 30d.

mike_runtime: Hosted defaults to 30d, Dedicated tenants can request 90d retention. I'll add a clarifying note in the PR. Also adding the Prom query we use to flag ratecap breaches: 
```promql
sum(increase(ratecap_exceeded_total[5m])) by (team)
```

lighthouse-bot: Deploy preview ready: https://deploy.preview.redwood.dev/452 — panels and snippets visible.

clara_devex: LGTM on the header example and curl snippet. One ask: include a short JS snippet showing how to set the header in fetch and an example of the SDK helper that computes billable units.

anne_docs: Will add the JS snippet and a brief migration note for customers moving from the legacy header `X-Redwood-Quota` to `X-Redwood-Usage`. Also adding a tiny table mapping old tier names to new canonical names.

sara_product: I can supply the mapping table content and a microcopy row for the tooltip. Sending DM with mocks.

kevin_design: :thumbsup: Looks good. CI checks green?

mike_runtime: CI was failing due to a lint rule; fixed and re-ran tests, all green now. You should be good after one more docs + product ack.

anne_docs: OK — I'll wait 5m then merge if no objections. Thanks all! :party_popper:
